review.rationale: The CE-G12-P Decision strictly enforces a read-only preflight with exact SSH host binding (hongyan-4cj, 180.76.115.193, root, port 22, identities-only), one-session cap, and P01-P10 checks that avoid raw log/journal/IP/environment/credential reads. Release and baseline bindings are immutable and hash-verified. Correlation binding preserves non-authority (authorization_status NOT_AUTHORIZED, authority_effect false, binding_is_permission false). Privacy contract excludes all sensitive persistence and limits output to sanitized fields. Caps and stop conditions comprehensively block writes, reloads, deployments, retries, fallbacks, and boundary violations. Execution is explicitly separated from Decision preparation and requires remote verification before any SSH action. All non-authorizations are complete and authority boundaries preserved. No blockers or corrections identified.
